VERDICT: FAIL

The evidence supports criterion (2) — all 47 tests pass per the CI log. However, criterion (1) — "the bug is fixed" — is not actually verified by the provided evidence. There is no diff/code change shown, no test that specifically reproduces the off-by-one batch-cursor bug and now passes, and no demonstration that the reconciler handles the boundary case correctly. Passing tests could simply mean no test covers the buggy condition. Without evidence tying the fix to the specific defect, the acceptance criteria are not demonstrably satisfied.
